name: Jellyfin Content Filter
overview: Scan and filter objectionable content using a local LLM
description: A Jellyfin plugin that scans media files for objectionable content categories using a local Ollama LLM instance and stores results as JCF sidecar files. During playback, flagged segments can be automatically skipped or muted based on per-category preferences.

versions.changelog: Fix mouse wheel volume hijacking in video player, isolate modal wheel and key events, keep modal clamped within viewport, and default Rules accordion groups to collapsed.

Enhance TheTimestampDudes downloader with configurable credentials, .env and JSON config support, and secure credential handling.

Draggable in-player Cue Editor HUD, edit existing cue tags and parameters, flexible timecode typing (mm:ss, seconds), and isolated player input handling.
Add in-player Video Cue Editor HUD overlay with Mark Start/End, frame nudging, Active Cues management, and backend global cue offset (time-shift) API.

Improve JCF file import flow: zero-config sidecar auto-discovery, interactive media library search, drag-and-drop dropzone with preview, and multi-file batch import.
